name: fix-init-library-agents-md
body: Amendment for agentic authoring. Source statement: `kalide init-library <path>` writes `library.yaml`, the empty layout entries and `themes/default/theme.css`, and the created library loads cleanly (templates-dir-validation). Inconsistency: the locked decision that init-library ships an `AGENTS.md` at the library root conflicts with templates-dir-layout's rule that unknown top-level entries in a library are an error (confirmed in internal/template/loadlibrary.go checkTopLevelLayout, which allows only library.yaml, slides, sections, themes, media): the guide would make the created library fail to load. Resolution [autonomous, FLAGGED]: amend requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout to permit the single inert root entry `AGENTS.md`, add requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout to state and test the exception, and record the guide write in requirements.requirement.init-library (library-agent-guide). Every other unknown top-level entry still errors. [with user: init-library ships a guide at the library root; autonomous: the layout exception that makes it load-valid]
